name: ADE Advanced Red Laser
description: The ADE Advanced Red Laser is the brightest red laser allowed by law. With a modern accessory rail, the laser sight fits virtually any firearm.

name: DBAL-I2
description: The Steiner DBAL-I2 (Dual Beam Aiming Laser) is a lightweight, military-grade laser aiming device designed for use in low-light and night vision environments. It features a visible laser and an infrared (IR) laser, and includes an adjustable windage and elevation system, a push-button switch, and a remote cable activation pad. The DBAL-I2 mounts to any Picatinny rail with a quick-release system and is waterproof up to five meters.

name: MAWL-C1
description: The world's first commercially available NIR and visible green laser aiming device utilizing Class 1+ technology, delivering more infrared illumination output power than any FDA Class 3R or Class 1 laser currently on the market.

name: NcStar Compact Green Laser
description: The ncSTAR Green Laser is a sleek and powerful tactical accessory featuring a 532nm Class IIIa laser with a maximum output of less than 5mw. Its swift deployment is facilitated by a Weaver-style mount, while its fully adjustable windage and elevation features come complete with a handy adjustment tool. With an ambidextrous sliding on/off switch, this laser is both versatile and user-friendly. Constructed from robust aluminum with a stylish black anodized finish and powered by a CR2 lithium battery, it's a sophisticated and efficient tool for a variety of applications.

name: NcStar LED FlashLight
description: A compact tactical flashlight with 150 lumens of peak output, featuring a quick-release mount compatible with most Weaver/Picatinny rails, ideal for full-sized semi-automatic pistols.

name: Olight Odin
description: The Olight Odin Series is a rugged, high performance tactical flashlight designed specifically for weapon mounting via innovative Picatinny rail attachments. Known for their high lumen output, long beam distance and durable construction.
